faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Rohnert Park?
faq.answer: Rohnert Park homeowners typically invest $4,500 to $10,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This planned Sonoma County city features uniform 1960s–1980s tract homes in its many village neighborhoods, making replacement projects highly efficient and cost-effective. Single window installation starts at approximately $430.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Rohnert Park?
faq.answer: Yes. Rohnert Park requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of Rohnert Park Community Development Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Rohnert Park?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Rohnert Park commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Rohnert Park?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Rohnert Park replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Rohnert Park?
faq.answer: Most Rohnert Park projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
